item.text:
This pass added the last end-to-end consistency property: replica convergence of applied state.

**New test: three-replica convergence** (`TestAuditStateMachineConvergence`)

A three-node cluster runs a state machine that accumulates a checksum of every applied payload. After 40 proposals, a snapshot on node 1, and 20 more proposals, every replica reports the same count (60) and checksum (1030). Because the check reads each node through `SyncRead` (a linearizable read of that node's applied state), it verifies that all replicas applied exactly the same sequence — including across snapshotting and log compaction. Passes 5/5.

Combined with the raft-level fuzz (leader uniqueness, log matching, commit monotonicity, vote uniqueness, leader self-vote, Leader Completeness), the audit now covers both halves of the state-machine replication argument: identical logs at the raft layer and identical applied state at the application layer.

**State**

- Findings unchanged: F1 (`(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` misses the engine wakeup), F2 (`handleCandidateReadIndex` records a dropped ReadIndex twice), F3 (`pb.Update.HasUpdate` ignores dropped read indexes). All reproduced on the unmodified tree, all fixed in `audit/diag-fixes/` with no regressions.
- Negative-result catalogue: protocol fuzz (now with six safety invariants), in-memory log model, vote-survives-restart, colfer entry encoding, follower/observer reads, leader transfer, witness election after leader loss, large payloads, dropped-read-index idempotence, restart endurance with snapshots, linearizability (single and cross-node), multi-cluster isolation, and now three-replica convergence.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) (595 lines) records the new test in the reviewed-areas list, inventory and command log, and the test is mirrored into the fix-verification copy.
